lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Before you swing, rookie rules. I talk, you listen. Aim with the arrow keys. Point her at the hole, not where the wind wants.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Arrows to aim. Even I can manage that. Then what?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Hold space to charge your shot, release to shoot. Longer hold, bigger swing. Do not get greedy in a gale.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: And these little weather gadgets?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Left-click places a field modifier where you point. Right-click picks one back up. Use hotkeys 1 to 4 to select an item in your bag. And if it all goes sideways, press R to reset to the tee, or press Escape to pause.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: One last rule before we walk, and it is the big one. You get 10 attempts per hole. Not per course. Per hole.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: And if I need an eleventh?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Then the trial is over and you start the whole course from the beginning. No mercy, no extra balls.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: So every shot counts twice.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Exactly. Plan your field modifiers well. Spend them where they win you the hole, not where they look pretty.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: No exceptions? No eleventh shot, ever?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Well... word is there are free shots out there. Shots that do not count. Rare as an honest Marshal. If one ever finds you, spend it like it is your last.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: The wind is straight against me here. One gadget will not turn it enough.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Then stack them. You can put field modifiers right on top of each other, and their winds combine.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Deflecting and rotating at once? That could send the gale anywhere.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Exactly. Deflecting and rotating turn the wind in unexpected directions. And magnifying a Rotator or a Deflector multiplies the whole trick.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: So I layer them until the wind draws the exact trajectory I need.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Now you are thinking like a weather criminal. Stack them high, aim true.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Listen up. When you have a good direction you want to keep, use a Liquifier — it nullifies the wind and preserves your line.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: If the wind is not blowing the way you need, use a Deflector to flip it 180 degrees or a Rotator to turn it 90 degrees.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: If you need more power, drop a Magnifier — it magnifies the wind five times.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: And remember: field modifiers can be placed on top of each other to combine their effects. Stack them wisely.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Two ways to earn an upgrade out here: grab a treasure chest, or clear the hole. Both pay out a reward.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: And I can pick anything I like?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Your golf bag holds four gadgets, no more. Pick a reward and it goes straight in — but if your bag is full, you'll have to drop one to make room.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: What about the gadgets I left sitting on the grass?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Gone when the hole clears. Placed is spent. So right-click them to pick them back up before you hole out — and if your bag is full, drop a spare first.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: You can only hold 4 items in your golf bag and if your bag is full you have to discard one to pick up another.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: You get a reward by clearing a hole or picking up treasure chests.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Chests are great if you are in need of more items but you have to balance how many attempts you spend trying to grab one.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: There are some passive items that you can always pick up even if your bag is full, they stack outside of your bag and you can carry how many you like.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Field Extender gives you +20% area for your modifiers, Power Cell gives +20% strength, and Free Shot gives you a free attempt that does not count.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Feel that? The old mountain is breathing again. Straight off the peak, as usual.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Then we breathe with it. Aim small, swing smooth, and let the gale do the arguing.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: One ball, ten tries, no putting. The Purists are watching, so make it pretty.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Same wind as yesterday, same impossible hole. I almost missed this.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Almost is for cowards, remember? The Marshal confiscates pants for almost.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Then hold my tee and watch. This one goes straight in, gale or no gale.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: That is the spirit. Disguise the gadgets, praise the aerodynamics, ace the hole.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Wind is shifty on this one. It wants your ball in the grey, do not give it away.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: If it drifts, I drift with it. The hole is just a suggestion until the ball says otherwise.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Easy now. Breathe, aim, and send it.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: You never told me your name Caddy.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: It's Jones.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Anything more than Jones?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: No, just Jones...

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: ...Caddy Jones.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: You read this wind like a weather report, May. Ever think of doing it on camera?

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: I used to work for television, actually. Field reporting. Mostly standing in storms, yelling into a microphone.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Explains the hair. And the complete lack of fear.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: The station taught me one thing: if the gale can carry your voice, it can carry your ball.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: If we ace this course, dinner is on me. Plain cheese. No arguments.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Plain? Coward. I once watched a guy order marshmallow, tuna, and extra cheese. At midnight. Near a storm drain.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: That is the most disgusting sentence ever aimed at me, and I have met the Grand Marshal.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Fine. Plain cheese. Champions eat boring.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: This pocket gadget is acting up again. Which way do I even point it?

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Try turning the device to channel 6. It likes that one. Trust me.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Channel 6? That is oddly specific.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: A very reliable source told me. Now hush and let me aim.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Nice helmet. New?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Hockey helmet. Regular one, plain, no mask. I am not a goalie and I do not pretend to be one.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Good. The last thing I need is my caddy hiding his face from a little wind.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: The wind can try. The helmet stays. The ball goes in.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: What do you listen to before a big shot? I need something fast.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Depends. Some days I want wild, off-beat jazz with drums going sideways. Other days I want a slow, steady island groove swaying under it.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: So, chaos first, sway second. Got it.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Exactly. Swing like the drums, land like the bassline.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: This green would make a fine chapel ceiling. Shame all I can paint is a slice.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: The old High Renaissance masters would weep. All that anatomy study, all that light, and we use it to chase a ball.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Four geniuses, one golden age, and not a single golf lesson among them.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Then we will honor them the only way we can: with perfect form and zero mercy.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Something moved down by the drainage grate. Tell me that was the wind.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: That was no wind. Big fella, whiskers, tail, total confidence. He looked at me like I owed him rent.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: The sewers under this mountain are practically a second clubhouse.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Aye. And down there, he is the Grand Marshal.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: New idea: I ride down the fairway on a skateboard carrying your bag. Faster rounds, bigger crowds.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: You would wipe out on the first warp in the turf and take my liquifiers with you.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Worth it. Four wheels, one plank, pure freedom. The Purists would faint.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: The answer is no. But if you land this caddy job well, I will let you push me to the next tee.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: There is green slime on my ball. Glowing, faintly warm, deeply suspicious slime.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Do not touch it. Last time I touched strange glowing goo, I grew three inches and an attitude.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Wipe it on the rough and pretend it never happened. Some things are better left unmutated.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Agreed. If it starts talking, though, I am keeping it as a caddy.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Kids these days collect little plastic heroes, you know. Poseable. Kung-fu grip. Very serious business.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: And let me guess: you kept yours in mint condition, in the box, on a shelf?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Four of them. Never opened. Worth a fortune now, probably. Emotionally, I mean.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: When we win this course, I am buying you a fifth. That one you are allowed to take outside.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Question for the walk: ninjas. Favorite weapon. Go.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Katana. Clean, honest, two-handed commitment. What about you?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Bo staff. Reach for days, and nobody accidentally loses a finger. Though I respect the twin sai crowd and the nunchuck daredevils.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: A full set of four, then. Pity they only make one golf club at a time.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: You are fighting a strong head wind — place your Liquifier to remove the head wind and keep your shot straight.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: This head wind will push you back — use your Liquifier to remove the head wind.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Still stuck against that head wind? Your Liquifier will remove the head wind — place it and shoot straight.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: This upwards wind is pushing you off — try the Rotator, it will turn the upwards wind into forward wind.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Try the new gadgets you got from the old man — the Deflector, Rotator and Magnifier can turn this crosswind in your favour.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Congratulations May — you are now ready to take on the challenges of Mt. Aeoulus!

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Remember, on the real trials you only have 10 attempts per hole and any modifiers on the ground when a hole is cleared are lost.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Item management is the key to clear a course. Choose wisely, place wisely.
